NameMultiLanguage.zh: 危机合约-武林寺庙第一部分-day7

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All zombies gain +30% movement speed, +30% health, +30% attack damage, and +30% armor durability
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有僵尸的移动速度，生命值，攻击力和防具耐久度+30%

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Hammer Zombies gain +80% health, with significantly increased parry duration and reflected projectile damage
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有捶鼓僵尸的生命值+80%，反弹时间和反弹子弹伤害大幅提升

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Torch Zombies and Bomb Zombies gain +40% movement speed and +20% health
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有习武火把和自爆僵尸的移动速度+40%，生命值+20%

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Rocket Imps gain +80% health, +80% movement speed, and +80% attack damage, with significantly reduced rocket speed multiplier but increased quantity
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有火箭小鬼的生命值，移动速度和攻击力+80%，火箭速度倍率大幅降低但是数量增加

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Certain plants are disabled, and additional Kongfu Racks appear
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 禁用部分植物，出现额外兵器架
